name: Kerberos authentications per second
description: Average performance counter per selected computer and instance.
kql:
Perf
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| where ObjectName == "Security System-Wide Statistics" and CounterName == "Kerberos Authentications"
| summarize Value = avg(CounterValue) by Timestamp = bin(TimeGenerated, _BinSize), Series = Computer, Dimension = InstanceName
| order by Timestamp asc
